question: Approve the ideation scope for a Reports month picker (jump-to-month UI modeled on the existing DatePickerModal) to proceed to spec?

artifacts.summary: Add a month picker to Reports so the captain can jump directly to any month instead of stepping one month at a time, styled/interacted like the existing DatePickerModal (Home/History/Subscriptions/expense-edit). Out of scope: changing DatePickerModal's day-picking behavior, changing what Reports shows once a month is selected, and an Annual-view picker (spec to confirm if needed). Spec stage resolves: DatePickerModal's actual UI shape, hooking into existing Monthly nav state vs new state, year-jumping, and whether to build a sibling MonthPickerModal or extend DatePickerModal with a mode.
